messages:
cam: heads-up: telemetry spike this morning in NA aggregates, looks like ~8% of hourly windows are under-target. root cause points to delayed kafka partitions between 01:10-02:40. thinking we should discuss approach: adaptive sampling resample vs full delta-recompute. thoughts?
priya: prefer adaptive sampling first. much cheaper and we can measure drift. full delta hits billing hard and can lock priority lanes.
thomas: +1 for adaptive but we need stronger safety gates. last time sampling missed edge-case joins and we had to run a follow-up full pass. can we add join-key shadow checks?
yara: shadow checks sound right. also console UX needs a "risk score" indicator for each run (estimate of expected drift and cost) so analysts know when to escalate. current run UI just shows % sampled.
grace: ops note: whatever we choose, flag the job with `preemptable=true` for low-priority runs. if we do a full delta, mark it `preemptable=false` and schedule during maintenance window. quota teams must approve.
cam: requirement: no SLO miss >2% for 24h window. if a sampling run projects >2% residual, fallback to delta-recompute for affected tenant set.
thomas: ok, algorithm idea: 1) sample 10% across affected windows 2) compute per-tenant drift estimate and variance 3) for tenants with drift_est > 0.5% and variance high -> escalate to 50% sample for a second pass 4) if still >2% plan full delta for that tenant only. keeps cost bounded.
priya: agree. need to capture metadata on run: sampling_seed, sample_buckets, run_hash so we can reproduce non-deterministic sampling. Also ensure `--dry-run` mode compares aggregated results without writing to aggregates.
yara: console change: show "expected tokens" estimate and a link to cost breakdown (token cost, decode cost, IO cost). people keep misreading sample percent as units. add tooltip.
infra-bot: created draft run run_2026_3740004321 (state: pending_canary). watchers: @cam @priya @thomas. ETA: 2026-04-02T05:00Z UTC.
cam: for canary let's pick a tenant with moderate traffic and complex joins: mojo-shop. run on shard na-4 only. 10% first pass.
thomas: include shadow-join-checker and metrics: join_mismatch_rate, agg_delta_pct, kv_reads. abort if join_mismatch_rate > 0.1% or agg_delta_pct > 3%.
priya: remind: when we measure agg_delta_pct use normalized keyset intersection to avoid noise from churn. we have a helper in /ops/recompute/utils. use that.
yara: console request: add a small "why fallback happened" message to run history to help postmortem. too many runs just show failed without context.
grace: filing a temporary quota bump for resample-low lane in case the canary expands. pinging #eng-sre with tag resample-need.
cam: also add routing policy: shard-affinity + spread-out-start to avoid simultaneous spikes on controllers. we want start times jittered by 90-300s.
thomas: good. and we should include a TTL on run artifacts: 30d by default, extendable. otherwise storage costs balloon.
priya: how do we handle event-order sensitivity? some aggregates are order-dependent; sampling might produce non-monotonic results. we should detect monotonicity violations in dry-run and force delta for those keys.
yara: add a UI toggle: "enforce-monotonic-safe" that when on makes system auto-fallback for keys that are not monotonic in the sampled run. default off, but recommended for financial metrics.
cam: ops-bot: kick the canary now.
infra-bot: run_2026_3740004321 transitioned to running (canary). logs: https://ops.redwood.ai/runs/run_2026_3740004321/logs
cam: interim: canary 10% done. agg_delta_pct ~0.4% global, join_mismatch_rate 0.02%, kv_reads down 12%. looks promising.
priya: proceed to adaptive roll: double sample to 20% for tenants with drift_est between 0.5-1.5%. keep 10% for others.
thomas: rolling policy: +20% sample cap per shard per hour, and abort if any controller node p95 latency increases >2s.
yara: created ticket CONS-9401 for console risk-score and the fallback message.
grace: reminder: snapshot dashboard and tag with run id for audit. also set retention flag on logs for 90 days for this run (sensitive).
cam: wrap-up: adaptive sampling plan approved. docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/backfills/adaptive-3740004321. i'll close thread when run completes. :white_check_mark:
